$comment: The issue section catalogue (HR-4; SDD plan piece P6). One catalogue owns the headings an issue Hatsu files carries per kind, which of them must be present and non-empty, the row shapes inside them, and the two word lists the acceptance rows are read against. Every heading is a level-2 heading matched case-insensitively. scripts/issue_body_check.mts reads this file and nothing else for the shape; templates/issue-body/<kind>.md is the body each kind starts from. A body checked with no --kind is read against `common` only. Acceptance criteria state intent, never technology: a flag, a verb or a path belongs in Plan notes alone. Owed to nen as `nen issue body-check` (zheref/nen#476) and `nen issue questions` (zheref/nen#477).

reproduction.heading: Reproduction
reproduction.$comment: A defect's repro steps, expected against actual, platform and build, frequency (hatsu:file section 2).

failing-run.heading: Failing run
failing-run.$comment: A machinery defect's failing run link and what the guard should have done instead (hatsu:file section 2).

missing-rule.heading: Missing rule
missing-rule.$comment: A canon gap's missing or wrong rule and what a reader did instead because of it (hatsu:file section 2).

children.heading: Children
children.$comment: An epic's child issues or planned slices, one per line.

entities.heading: Key entities
entities.$comment: Required only when the issue captures data; never required by a kind.

design-direction.heading: Design Direction
design-direction.$comment: Bisky's section for a brief naming a rendered surface (hatsu:emperor-time section 3).

plan-notes.heading: Plan notes
plan-notes.$comment: The only section where a flag, a verb or a path may appear.

success.shape: - SC-{n}: <a measurable outcome carrying a number or a percentage>
